items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Pascal, Al Pascal, that was the man's name. Al Pascal. He was instrumental in getting me on the show

ctx.x: And restored. I must keep that, you know.

But this was a marvelous thing, and I used to sit, you know, whenever I could and watch the different subjects on the show. And Ralph Edwards, who is a wonderful man, and such a personable man, and he -- he had -- isn't that funny, what is the guy's name? I can't even think of his name now. But was instrumental in really getting me on the show, and he had a girl working for him, and this girl, she was a maid, and the girl was a friend of mine, and she was instrumental in getting me, you know, getting me on the…

He was instrumental in getting me on the show, you know. He wanted me -- but I of course didn't know that. I wasn't supposed to know that I was going to be the subject of the show. And I was told that I was going to do -- what is the woman's name? Oh, dear, used to be a dancer. She was a marvelous
